title: Coalitions, Dissent & Debate Pivots
goal: Pivot between concession and condition in public debate with formal contrast connectors

items: I can place no obstante parenthetically mid-clause and use con todo and ahora bien as parliamentary pivots.
I can distinguish a concession pivot (con todo) from a conditional caveat (ahora bien) in public debate.
I can use coalition, opposition, dissent, and social-dialogue vocabulary in C1 discourse.
